title: Chiffon Halter Sleeveless A-Line Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Float down the aisle in elegance with this chiffon bridesmaid dress! Featuring a sleeveless design and a flattering A-line silhouette, this timeless piece ensures effortless grace and comfort, making it perfect for celebrating love in style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
